model.name: 10Eros Max H3 TURBO hybrid beta5 INT8 (Ref2VA)
model.description: 10Eros-Max beta5 hybrid finetune for Reference-to-Video-and-Audio. TURBO delta is baked into the checkpoint, so no separate turbo LoRA is needed. INT8 quantized.
model.infos:
## 10Eros Max H3 TURBO hybrid beta5 (INT8)
A hybrid finetune with the reference and first/last-frame turbo deltas fused into the weights, so no turbo LoRA has to be loaded. Intended to work in both Ref2VA and FL2VA modes (also registered as a separate FL2VA finetune).

Recommended sampling (per author):
- RES Multistep, 6-8 steps (best motion)
- Euler, 4-8 steps

Notes:
- Turbo is built in: do not add a turbo LoRA.
- For reference generation, author recommends disabling cache and spectrum to avoid accuracy loss.
- Quantization is INT8 (RTX 30-series or newer for the INT8 kernels).
